skill.name: firecrawl-search
skill.description: Search the web with Firecrawl, save structured results, and optionally extract full page markdown from matching pages.
skill.summary: Run Firecrawl web searches and capture source content for research workflows.
skill.author: firecrawl

static_findings.snippet: | `--scrape`                           | Also scrape full page content for each result |
- **`--scrape` fetches full content** — don't re-scrape URLs from search results. This saves credits
- Always write results to `.firecrawl/` with `-o` to avoid context window bloat.
- Use `jq` to extract URLs or titles: `jq -r '.data.web[].url' .firecrawl/search.json`

content.value_statement: Current web research often needs more than short search snippets. This skill runs Firecrawl searches, saves structured results, and can extract full page content for review.
actual_capabilities: Runs Firecrawl search commands for web research queries.
Searches web, image, and news sources through Firecrawl options.
Applies time, country, location, and category filters supported by the CLI.
Scrapes full page content from search results when requested.
Saves JSON search output to local .firecrawl files.
Shows how to extract result URLs or titles with jq.
limitations: Requires Firecrawl CLI or npx Firecrawl access in the agent environment.
Search quality depends on Firecrawl coverage and page accessibility.
Full page scraping may use Firecrawl credits and can duplicate content.
The skill does not verify source credibility by itself.

use_cases.title: Find Sources for Research Briefs
use_cases.description: Discover relevant articles and pages before summarizing a topic or preparing a report.

use_cases.title: Collect Technical References
use_cases.description: Locate GitHub, research, PDF, or documentation pages for engineering investigations.

use_cases.title: Track Recent Coverage
use_cases.description: Search news sources from a selected time window and save results for later review.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Web Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the web for reliable sources about remote patient monitoring adoption and save the results for review.

prompt_templates.title: Recent News Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Find news from the past day about new battery recycling regulations and summarize the strongest sources.

prompt_templates.title: Filtered Source Discovery
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for research and PDF sources about secure software supply chains, limit results to high quality sources, and save the output.

prompt_templates.title: Search and Extract Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Find current sources about AI data center energy demand, scrape full page content from the best results, and prepare a source list.

output_examples.input: Search for recent articles about enterprise browser security.
output: A saved Firecrawl result file with article titles, URLs, source names, and publication context.
A short summary of the most relevant sources and remaining research gaps.

output_examples.input: Find research pages about carbon removal measurement standards.
output: A curated list of matching research, PDF, and web results.
Notes on which sources should be scraped for full page evidence.

output_examples.input: Search news from the last day about a public company announcement.
output: A saved news search result set with recent coverage.
A concise comparison of headlines, sources, and repeated claims.

best_practices: Use clear search terms and filters before requesting full page scraping.
Save outputs under .firecrawl so large results do not overload the conversation.
Review source quality before using scraped content in final answers.
anti_patterns: Do not scrape every result when snippets and URLs are enough.
Do not treat search ranking as proof that a source is reliable.
Do not store sensitive user information in search queries or output filenames.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It uses Firecrawl to search the web and optionally extract full page content from matching results.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it search recent news?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents news sources and time filters such as results from the past day.

faq.question: Does it save results locally?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill recommends saving structured output under the .firecrawl directory.

faq.question: Does it always scrape full pages?
faq.answer: No. Full page scraping is optional and should be used when snippets are not enough.

faq.question: What should users verify?
faq.answer: Users should verify source credibility, publication dates, and whether scraped content answers the original question.
